data.body: Closing as duplicate of 4100-95a4-07ce-41ab (P0, open). Both epics describe a pre-record verifier agent that re-reads cited files/excerpts and emits confirm/downgrade/drop per finding; 4100-95a4 has the more detailed scope (input/output contract, runner.py dispatch step, schema for verifier rulings, behavioral test fixtures, telemetry) and is at P0. RC-B handoff context (F4-F7b mapping + bug ticket fixtures) added as a decomposition input on 4100-95a4. Closing this ticket under user authorization 2026-05-12.
